methods.timing: 4/4 only; subtatum=0; division=1/2 tatum=1 onsets; division=2 tatum=2 offbeats; local annotated beat duration. Per-solo medians, then median/IQR across solos (>=20 notes per statistic). Not an exact replication of Nelias et al.
limitations: Tapped beats are an annotated reference, not measured drum offbeats.
IQR is dispersion, not confidence interval.
Corpus chord parser intentionally excludes unsupported labels.
Four-interval repetition is an exact transposition-invariant proxy, not complete motif recognition.
Articulation gap is not a notated rest.
Timing summaries exclude triplets, sixteenths and ornaments.
